Hi Marta / Aaron —

Great to meet earlier today. Per our discovery, I put together a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the vendor onboarding / procurement milestones needed to complete contracting and start Redwood Dedicated in your environment. See milestones below and a draft MAP attached (Acme-MAP-v1.xlsx).

- Vendor form + W-9 submission: Owner — Acme Procurement (Marta) / Target — 2026-06-18

- Contract signature (DocuSign): Owner — Redwood (Camila) + Acme Legal / Target — 2026-06-25
- Initial onboarding kick-off & technical connect: Owner — Redwood (Marissa) / Target — 2026-06-29

Key dependencies:
- Ariba/Coupa supplier record created (required before Redwood can invoice).
- Completed W-9 and bank details for ACH.
- Legal review window (estimate 3 business days once final SOW is returned).

Next steps:
1) Marta: confirm whether Acme prefers Ariba or Coupa and share the supplier form link.
2) Aaron: confirm banking contact and whether you need a Redwood vendor packet (we can attach standard banking paperwork).
3) Marissa: I’ll share the final SOW and DocuSign envelope once you confirm the portal and W-9.

Attached: Acme-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min follow-up if helpful.
